You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Is the periodic verification of the DEMAG overhead crane at position 8 of the IGEA list overdue today?

Facts:
[0] periodic verifications of comma 11 for equipment in annex VII — verifiedBy — Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco (Corpo nazionale dei vigili del fuoco) [condition: relativamente alle attrezzature riportate nell'allegato VII di cui dispone a titolo di proprietà o comodato d'uso] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13-bis]
[1] regular inspection of machinery or related product — verifiedBy — designated bodies (designated bodies) [condition: may be subject to national requirements for regular inspection] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.10]
[2] operator — hasObligation — have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times (have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times) [REG, Annex III, 1.7.1.2]
[3] periodic audits — verifiedBy — The notified body (the notified body) [DIR, Annex X]
[4] relevant technical documentation for partly completed machinery — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex VII]
[5] 4.3.3 lifting machinery, maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[6] lifting machinery maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[7] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (annex IV point 16) [DIR, Annex IV]
[8] datore di lavoro, controllo dopo ogni montaggio — hasObligation — dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto (dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[9] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report (a test report) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[10] guards at landings — requiresMeasure — interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier (interlocking device controlled by the position of the carrier) [condition: hazardous movements of the carrier until the guards are closed and locked] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.5]
[11] driver checking position of devices exceeding clearance zone — requiresMeasure — the means of checking easily (the means of checking easily) [condition: Where, for operating purposes, machinery is fitted with devices which exceed its normal clearance zone] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.2]
[12] movement of the machinery — requiresMeasure — must depend on safe positioning (must depend on safe positioning) [condition: Where it does not give rise to other risks] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.2]
[13] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a copy of the load plate or load table (a copy of the load plate or load table) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[14] essential requirement 6.4.3, access to the carrier — requiresMeasure — guards at the landings and on the carrier (guards at the landings and on the carrier) [condition: taking into consideration the foreseeable range of goods and persons to be lifted] [DIR, Annex I, 6.4.3]
[15] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests (test report on static and dynamic tests) [condition: where appropriate] [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]
[16] lifting machinery marking — requiresMeasure — legible, indelible and in an un-coded form (legible, indelible and in an un-coded form) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[17] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[18] adjustment and maintenance points — requiresMeasure — located outside danger zones (located outside danger zones) [REG, Annex III, 1.6.1]
[19] distributors — hasObligation — distributors shall verify that (verify that machinery bears the CE marking) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[20] machinery serving fixed landings — listedIn — 6.4. (Annex I, point 6.4) [DIR, Annex I, 6.4]
[21] loading control 4.2.2 — requiresMeasure — devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements (devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements) [condition: with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kg or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm] [REG, Annex III, 4.2.2]
[22] essential requirement 3.4.1 — addressesRisk — uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity (uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity) [condition: when moved] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.1]
[23] movable guards — requiresMeasure — guard locking device (guard locking device) [condition: Where it is possible for an operator to reach the danger zone before the risk due to the hazardous machinery functions has ceased] [DIR, Annex I, 1.4.2.2]
[24] essential requirement 4.1.2.8.4 — addressesRisk — Risk due to the load falling off the carrier (risk due to the load falling off the carrier) [condition: Where there is a risk] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.4]
[25] essential requirement 1.6.2, access to operating positions and servicing points — requiresMeasure — allow access in safety (allow access in safety) [condition: where intervention is necessary during operation, adjustment and maintenance of the machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.2]
[26] adjustment and maintenance points — requiresMeasure — must be located outside danger zones (must be located outside danger zones) [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.1]
[27] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (vehicle servicing lifts) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
[28] 1.2.4.4 assembly of machinery — requiresMeasure — stop controls, including the emergency stop devices (stop controls, including the emergency stop devices) [condition: if its continued operation may be dangerous] [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.4.4]
[29] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product (for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[30] essential requirement 3.4.1 — addressesRisk — uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity (uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity) [condition: when moved] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.1]
[31] loading control 4.2.2 — addressesRisk — overturning moment being exceeded (overturning moment being exceeded) [REG, Annex III, 4.2.2]
[32] warning prohibiting lifting of persons — requiresMeasure — visible (visible) [condition: where access is possible] [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[33] portable hand-held machinery — requiresMeasure — visual observation of the danger zone (visual observation of the danger zone) [condition: where necessary] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.1]
[34] control devices for carrier movements — requiresMeasure — control devices authorising automatic stops at preselected positions (control devices authorising automatic stops at preselected positions) [condition: If there is no risk of persons or objects on the carrier colliding or falling and no other risks due to the upward and downward movements of the carrier] [REG, Annex III, 6.2]
[35] carrier doors — requiresMeasure — doors must remain closed (doors must remain closed) [condition: if the carrier stops between landings where there is a risk of falling from the carrier] [DIR, Annex I, 6.4.1]
[36] digital assembly instructions made accessible online — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[37] emergency stop devices — listedIn — Emergency stop devices (annex v, point 10) [DIR, Annex V]
[38] datore di lavoro, interventi di controllo periodici — hasObligation — interventi di controllo periodici (interventi di controllo periodici) [condition: secondo frequenze stabilite in base alle indicazioni fornite dai fabbricanti, ovvero dalle norme di buona tecnica] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[39] manufacturer of the machinery — hasObligation — ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art (ensuring that the said machinery meets the corresponding state of the art) [DIR, Annex IX]
[40] machinery CE marking date — hasObligation — It is prohibited to pre-date or post-date the machinery (it is prohibited to pre-date or post-date the machinery) [condition: when affixing the CE marking] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.3]
[41] Dynamic test — definedAs — the test during which lifting machinery is operated in all its possible configurations (the test during which lifting machinery is operated in all its possible configurations) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.1]
[42] EC declaration of conformity — hasObligation — the place and date of the declaration (the place and date of the declaration) [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[43] 4.1.2.7 operating position of machinery — requiresMeasure — widest possible view of trajectories (widest possible view of trajectories) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.7]
[44] emergency stop device disengagement — requiresMeasure — only by an appropriate operation (only by an appropriate operation) [condition: disengaging shall not restart the machinery but only permit restarting] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.4.3]
[45] 4.3.3 machinery with configuration-dependent working load — requiresMeasure — load plate (load plate) [condition: Where the maximum working load depends on the configuration of the lifting machinery or related product] [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[46] essential requirement 4.1.2.8.4 — addressesRisk — Risk due to the load falling off the carrier (risk due to the load falling off the carrier) [condition: Where there is a risk due to the load falling off the carrier] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.8.4]
[47] modalità di effettuazione delle verifiche periodiche — hasTimeLimit — entro dodici mesi (P12M) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 13]
[48] essential requirement 4.1.2.8.4 — requiresMeasure — designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent this risk (designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent this risk) [condition: Where there is a risk due to the load falling off the carrier] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.8.4]
[49] loading control — requiresMeasure — fitted with devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements (fitted with devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements) [condition: Machinery with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kilograms or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm] [DIR, Annex I, 4.2.2]

response.text: {"kind":"unknown","value":null,"text":"The facts do not say whether this verification is overdue. They contain nothing about the IGEA list, the DEMAG overhead crane at position 8, or the date of its last periodic verification, and no verification interval for the crane. Art. 71, c. 13 only sets a 12-month limit for the modalities of carrying out periodic verifications, which cannot be applied to this crane without those dates.","used":[47]}
